title: Pointwise normalized comparison of integral tower generators
statement:
The Lean theorem `integralInverseSystem_unit_normalization_components` has the following statement:

theorem integralInverseSystem_unit_normalization_components (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : ∀ n : ℕ, SheafOfModules.AlgebraicInverseImage (Scheme.proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))) ((Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n)) ((Rrings l X).obj (Opposite.op n))) (P : WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.OrdinaryInverseSystem.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n)) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Scheme.proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).obj (Opposite.op n)) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) I) (FY : Forget Y (Rrings l Y)) (FX : Forget X (Rrings l X)) (e : FY.F ⋙ abPull f ≅ P.pull ⋙ FX.F) : ∃ i : P.pull.obj (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y)) ≅ coefficient X (Rrings l X), ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (((abPull f).obj (integers Y)).obj (op n)).obj.obj U), (((((abPull f).map (integerGenerator Y (Rrings l Y) FY)) ≫ e.hom.app (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y))) ≫ FX.F.map i.hom).app (op n)).hom.app U x = ((integerPull f ≫ integerGenerator X (Rrings l X) FX).app (op n)).hom.app U x

proof.text: Construct the coefficient isomorphism level by level from the ringUnderlying and moduleUnderlying comparisons in the algebraic inverse image and the component maps of the ordinary inverse system. The ring addition, multiplication, zero and one equations make the maps linear and send constant integer sections to the corresponding integer sections. The transition equation of the ordinary inverse system assembles the level maps, and the Forget section formulas identify their values with the displayed pointwise equality.
